// model: Default only. Per-loop choices below are what actually run; see .opencode/agents/.
// permission: Baseline ONLY. Every value here is 'allow' or 'deny' and never 'ask': an unattended loop
cannot answer a prompt, so an 'ask' is a run that hangs until its timeout.
Web access is deliberately NOT set here. It is a PER-LOOP capability -- forage needs it,
research and leap must not have it -- and a global 'deny' here resolved onto the forage agent
and would have silently broken the only loop that needs the web.
// agent: MODEL SPLIT, on purpose. The research loop is a 45-minute agentic run with subagent
delegation and a strict JSON trailer -- exactly where a cheap model fails and the cost of
failure is a wasted cycle. It gets the best model available.
Leap and forage are short, high-volume and cheap to redo, and they used to share the research
loop's quota: on 2026-09-13 three consecutive research runs came back rate_limited and two
produced nothing. Pointing them at a DIFFERENT provider means they stop competing for the
subscription that the expensive loop depends on.
